subject: im
question: Difference between EOQ and EPQ.
title: Bought vs Baked Stock
hook: Same shop, two ways to get bread.
answer: EOQ is for purchased items; EPQ is for manufactured (made in-house) items.
EOQ: the whole order arrives at once, stock jumps to Q then falls. EPQ: stock builds up gradually while production and use run together; peak stays below Q.
EOQ uses ordering cost + holding cost; EPQ uses setup cost + holding cost.
EPQ = square root of (2DS / (H x (1 - d/p))), where d = demand rate and p = production rate.
